text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No way... I lost...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I'm not at the stage yet to talk about "following my seniors" or "chasing ideals.")

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how much I chase, I can't close the gap!
If anything, they're pulling further and further away!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No... No, if I stay like this, I...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I want to be like my seniors!
Otherwise, there's no way I can ever
become a new glory...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to... I have to do something...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let me run in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The instant she returned to the waiting room, Mejiro Dober
said that to me with a look of pure desperation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Once again... it was beaten into me.
If I'm losing in a place like this, I'm nowhere near good enough...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's no time to mope around!
This isn't like the Arima Kinen.
I've decided to keep taking on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-senpai will surely enter
the spring Grand Prix next—the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to aim for that too!
I want to race Senpai there again and seize victory!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What do I lack... to become like
Air Groove-senpai?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Not again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once again, that strange, familiar unease stirs within my chest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, without thinking—
choice_data_list: Are you really okay with that?
Are you really sure that's okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...What, what does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...If I haven't even put it into words yet,
there's no point in simply asking."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I resolved to think it over more
and find an answer before talking to Mejiro Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...What a weird Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, the next goal was set
as the Takarazuka Kinen.
